summary: Fix T52 root cause: _run_generate tool prompts said 'matching schema' without ever showing the schema, so both attempts returned parseable JSON missing required fields (pydantic type=missing). Add module-level _SCHEMA_HINTS mirroring services/structured_outputs.py::_prompt shapes and embed the concrete shape in both the initial generate prompt and the repair note.
final_report: T53 done. Root cause (per T52): _run_generate's prompts told the model to return 'ONLY JSON matching schema' / 'matching the schema exactly' but never showed any schema, so on unknown topics the model produced parseable JSON missing required fields -> pydantic ValidationError type='missing' -> {"error":"missing"} on BOTH attempts. Fix in app/llm/tools.py only (no import from app.services.structured_outputs; shapes duplicated verbatim per layering rule): (1) module-level _SCHEMA_HINTS with chat/mermaid/todo/quiz/latex shapes byte-identical to StructuredOutputService._prompt's schemas dict except latex, which uses the brief's '{

}' example so the model sees valid JSON-escaped LaTeX; (2) initial user prompt is now 'Generate ONLY the JSON for output_kind={kind} about: {topic}. Return ONLY this exact JSON shape: {shape}. Fill every field. The topic MUST stay within the current lesson thread ({topic}). Do not choose an unrelated subject.' with shape=_SCHEMA_HINTS.get(kind,'{}'); (3) repair note now 'Your previous answer could not be used ({stable_code}). Return ONLY corrected JSON for output_kind={kind} about {topic}, EXACTLY this shape: {shape}' - the shape rides along on attempt 2 too. Tests (tests/test_tools_loop.py): mermaid happy-path now asserts the LLM user message contains '"source"' and 'exact JSON shape'; todo repair test's exact-content assertion updated to the new wording including 'EXACTLY this shape: {"title":"...","items":[{"text":"...","done":false}]}'. Verification: python -m compileall app/llm/tools.py clean; python -m pytest tests/test_tools_loop.py -q => 10 passed. Pre-existing LSP typing noise (FakeLLM-vs-LLMClient param, httpx/httpx2 duplicate-package) untouched, outside scope. analyzer_pending: no tsc/eslint applies (Python); live Pi probe re-run owed to Merlin for behavioral confirmation.
